trait.name: Amphibie
entries: The hag can breathe air and water.

trait.name: Mimicry (Green Hag)
entries: The hag can mimic animal sounds and humanoid voices. A creature that hears the sounds can tell they are imitations with a successful {@dd 14}Sagesse ({@skill Perspicacité}) check.

action.name: Illusory Appearance
entries: The hag covers herself with a magical illusion that allows her to look like another creature of her general size and shape. The illusion ends lorsque the hag chooses, or if she dies. A {@dd 20}Intelligence ({@skill Investigation}) check will expose the hag's disguise.

action.name: Invisible Passage
entries: The hag magically turns {@condition invisible} until she attacks or casts a spell, or until her {@status concentration} ends. While {@condition invisible}, she leaves no physical evidence of her passage, and can only be tracked by magic.

entries: {@atk mw} {@hit 6} pour toucher, allonge 10 m,, one Medium or smaller creature. {@h}10 ({@dégât 2d6 + 3}) bludgeoningdgts. Target is {@condition agrippé} (escape {@dd 15}). The couatl can constrain only une cible at a time.

action.name: Change Shape
entries: The couatl magically polymorphs into {@filter a humanoid or beast that has a challenge rating equal to or less than its own|bestiary|Challenge Rating=[&0;&4]|type=beast;humanoid}, or back into its true form. It reverts to its true form if it dies. Any equipment it is wearing or carrying is absorbed or borne by the new form (the couatl's choice).

In a new form, the couatl retains its game statistics and ability to speak, but its AC, movement modes,Force,Dextérité, and other actions are replaced by those of the new form, and it gains any statistics and capabilities (except class features, legendary actions, and lair actions) that the new form has but that it lacks. Si  new form has a bite attack, the couatl can use its bite in that form.
